title: SLI Fingerprint Initiative Tracker and Confidence Scorer
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: As we scale Redwood’s Hosted and Dedicated customers, initiative prioritization for reliability work has grown noisy. Engineers and PMs lack a fast way to know which active experiments, rollouts, or config changes are most likely to trigger error-budget burn across different customer cohorts or routes. Current dashboards show historical SLI trends but do not surface structured signals tied to specific initiatives or provide a quantitative confidence level for predicted SLI impact.

Proposal: Build an 'SLI Fingerprint' model and Initiative Confidence Scorer that produces a per-initiative, per-route signature (fingerprint) describing the typical SLI delta pattern associated with similar changes. Use placebo/AB comparisons and historical initiative metadata to produce a confidence score (0-100) and a predicted error-budget impact range (e.g., 95% CI). Integrate outputs into the Initiative Hub and rollout gating so Product/Eng can quickly see which initiatives require stricter rollout limits or automated rollback criteria.

Scope & Deliverables:
- Data model: initiative metadata (tags, type, rollout percentage, code path), route/customer cohort mapping, and canonical SLI signals to compare (latency p50/p95, success rate, token-generation error rate).
- Fingerprint generation pipeline: feature extraction (temporal SLI deltas, seasonality), similarity search across historical initiatives, and a lightweight probabilistic impact estimator.
- Confidence Scorer: combines data freshness, sample size, historical precedent, and implementation similarity to produce a confidence value and rationale.
- UI: Initiative Hub card with predicted error-budget delta, confidence score, top historical analogs, and recommended rollout throttle (e.g., 5%/20%/50%).
- Alerts & gating: automated guardrail rule templates (e.g., auto-pause if projected monthly burn > 2x target) and a Slack/console alert for high-confidence high-impact initiatives.

Why this is different: instead of only reactive SLI thresholds, SLI Fingerprint creates evidence-based forecasts tied directly to initiative metadata so decisions are proactive and explainable.
acceptance_criteria: Initiative Hub displays per-initiative predicted error-budget impact range and a confidence score for at least 90% of initiatives created in a cycle.
Predicted ranges are computed using >= 3 historical analogs or clearly note low-sample confidence when analogs < 3.
UI exposes top-3 historical analog initiatives with links to their postmortems/dashboards.
Automated guardrail templates can be applied to an initiative and will trigger alerts when predicted impact exceeds configured thresholds.
Engineering reviews algorithm and approves production telemetry queries; model runs within 45s for a typical initiative card (budget < 60s SLA).
success_metrics: Reduce surprise SLO incidents related to active initiatives by 30% within 3 months of rollout
>60% of production rollouts adopt an automated guardrail recommended by the scorer for at least one high-risk initiative
Median time-to-decision for an initiative with non-trivial predicted impact reduced from 4 hours to <1 hour
False positive alert rate for high-confidence (>75) impact predictions below 12% after 6 weeks
